nodes.title: Network module: add connectivity history and interface status (like Stats)
nodes.body:
### Problem or Motivation

The Network module shows live speeds, a short speed graph, and per-app usage — but nothing about connection stability over time or the state of the interface itself. When the connection drops briefly, there's no way to see when it happened.

### Proposed Solution

Add what the Stats app shows on its Network panel:
Connectivity history — a timeline of up/down status (the green squares row in Stats), so you can see at a glance whether the connection dropped recently.
Network status section — interface up/down, internet connection up/down, total upload/download, latency/jitter, local and public IP.

This was written by Muse at my request.

### Feature Area

Essentials

### Mockups / References

_No response_

I opened #3399 for this. It adds a connectivity history, interface and internet status, latency, jitter, interface name, MAC address and public IP to the Network card, plus hover values on the speed graph.

The internet check and the public IP lookup send requests, so both are off by default and can be turned on from the card or in Settings → Monitor. Feedback welcome, especially on those defaults.

I’d especially appreciate being able to view my public IP in the Network section. I switched from Stats to Vorssaint and miss having that information available at a glance. Keeping the lookup off by default or letting users refresh it on demand sounds good.
